articles.title: Delhi to enforce annual ban on out-of-state BS-IV and older vehicles from November 1
articles.summary: The Delhi government will prohibit vehicles registered outside the national capital and below BS-VI emission standards from plying between November 1 and January 31 every year.

articles.title: Karnataka plans English-medium sections in all public schools
articles.summary: Karnataka plans to introduce English-medium sections in all 48,527 government schools from the next academic year to curb student migration to private institutions.

articles.title: Himachal executes first inter-state Golden Mahseer fingerling shipment to West Bengal
articles.summary: Himachal Pradesh's Department of Fisheries supplied 2,000 Golden Mahseer fingerlings to West Bengal to assess transportation challenges. This marks the state's first interstate fish fingerling supply, promoting quality indigenous fish species.

articles.title: Sri Lankan High Commission hosts Diwali with Diplomats, celebrates culture and friendship
articles.summary: The Sri Lankan High Commission hosted Diwali with Diplomats in New Delhi, bringing together international envoys for an evening of cultural performances, festive traditions and diplomatic friendship.

articles.title: Deepotsav: From a festival of lights to a ₹55-crore economic opportunity for Ayodhya
articles.summary: Jaiveer Singh, Minister of Tourism & Culture, Government of Uttar Pradesh, on how Deepotsav is transforming Ayodhya into a global tourism destination while creating livelihoods, attracting investment and strengthening the local economy.

articles.title: Centre plans second telecom PLI scheme to boost local value addition
articles.summary: The government had rolled out the first edition of the telecom PLI scheme with an outlay of ₹12,195 crore. The scheme ended in March 2026.

articles.title: Centre opens Semicon 2.0 portal, clears 12 electronics component projects worth ₹7,503 crore
articles.summary: Union IT Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said India's electronics manufacturing journey has moved beyond assembly towards building a comprehensive domestic value chain spanning modules, components, materials and advanced technologies.

articles.title: India set to join EU's €93.5 billion Horizon Europe programme, boosting scientific collaboration
articles.summary: India's proposed association with the EU's €93.5 billion Horizon Europe programme will enable Indian researchers, universities and businesses to access European research funding and lead multinational projects from 2027.

articles.title: UIDAI adds 300 offline verification entities; Aadhaar App nears 7.5 crore downloads nationwide
articles.summary: UIDAI expands Aadhaar-based offline verification with 300 entities as App downloads near 7.5 crore, enabling millions of mobile, address and email updates alongside enhanced digital identity security.

articles.title: From digital public infrastructure to public intelligence: Building sovereign, AI-ready services for India
articles.summary: As artificial intelligence reshapes public-service delivery, India’s next phase of digital transformation must balance intelligence and innovation with data sovereignty, cybersecurity, inclusion and citizen trust. At the inaugural Accelerating India Dialogues, senior government officials and TCS leaders examined how India can build sovereign, AI-ready public services that anticipate citizen needs, support better decision-making and strengthen governance at scale.

articles.title: DGTR recommends imposition of quantitative restrictions on soda ash imports for 2 years
articles.summary: The Directorate General of Trade Remedies has signaled its intention to introduce protective measures to curb the influx of soda ash imports.

articles.title: Bengal govt clears 393 private BEd colleges for admissions in 2026-28 session
articles.summary: Kolkata's Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay announced 393 private BEd colleges have been approved for future admissions.

articles.title: Rajasthan records highest-ever monthly GST, VAT collection of ₹7,047 crore in October
articles.summary: October revenue collection exceeds previous record of ₹6,826.60 crore set in March 2026; year-on-year growth of 11.79%.

articles.title: Rajasthan government schools record increase in enrollment after five years
articles.summary: Enrollment reaches 72.98 lakh in July 2026, an increase of 48,358 over 2025-26; 15 teachers selected under Star Teacher initiative.

articles.title: US midterm verdict: Oil prices to AI trade, 5 things that matter for India after Democrats’ sweep
articles.summary: Emkay Global outlines five implications for India, including lower crude oil prices, US bond yields, AI capex, tariff uncertainty and rupee stability following the Democrats’ capture of both chambers of Congress.

articles.title: RITES eyes ₹10000 crore order book, accelerates project execution and global expansion: Rahul Mithal CMD
articles.summary: RITES CMD Rahul Mithal outlines plans for double-digit revenue growth, a ₹10,000 crore order book, international expansion and new opportunities in infrastructure consultancy and digital trade corridors.

articles.title: Bengal CM pledges power subsidy to four lakh farmers, special package for cultivators in 3 districts
articles.summary: Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari announced new welfare measures for farmers in West Bengal. He stated that 46 lakh farmers would benefit from the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi scheme.

articles.title: Centre issues advisory to states to boost fodder production, livestock infra under VB-G RAM G
articles.summary: The Centre has issued a joint advisory to enhance fodder security and livestock infrastructure in rural areas. The advisory outlines 22 permissible works under the Viksit Bharat-Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission Act.

articles.title: Maharashtra targets 30% electric vehicle registrations by 2030 to drive a greener future
articles.summary: Maharashtra plans to secure a 30 percent market share of electric vehicles by 2030. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis announced the state’s aim during the launch of Mercedes-Benz's GLC Electric.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu registration department records ₹1,950 cr revenue in Oct 2026
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu registration department reported a revenue collection of ₹1,950 crore for October 2026. This indicates an increase from ₹1,803 crore collected in the same month last year.

articles.title: Bengal govt to include Syama Prasad Mookerjee in school curriculum, drop Singur chapter
articles.summary: West Bengal's government plans to introduce lessons on Syama Prasad Mookerjee in the school curriculum. The chapter discussing the Singur anti-land acquisition movement will be removed from Class 8 textbooks.

articles.title: Essar Power plans 300 MW renewable energy project in Andhra Pradesh
articles.summary: Essar Power’s renewable energy subsidiary plans to develop a 300 MW firm and dispatchable renewable energy project in Andhra Pradesh with NHPC. The company has indicated an investment of about ₹4,500 crore; project technology mix and commissioning timelines have not yet been detailed.

articles.title: Allocate 25% of corporate CSR funds to agriculture to improve farmer incomes: Jagjeet Kandal
articles.summary: India's fragmented agricultural markets need stronger farmer collectives, transparent procurement systems and better market access to ensure fair returns, responsible sourcing and long-term sustainability.

articles.title: Cabinet approves ₹4,371 crore VISTAR scheme to upgrade India’s statistical system
articles.summary: The Viksit Bharat Initiative for statistical transformation, analytics and research (VISTAR) scheme is for five years till 2030-31. It will be a central sector scheme.

articles.title: Cabinet okays ₹2,814 crore capex support scheme for domestic lithium, nickel processing
articles.summary: The scheme will provide a 30 per cent capital subsidy for setting up four critical mineral processing plants, comprising two lithium facilities and two nickel facilities, to reduce import dependence and strengthen domestic supply chains.

articles.title: Cabinet approves VISTAR initiative for statistical transformation
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the Viksit Bharat Initiative for Statistical Transformation, Analytics & Research (VISTAR), with an outlay of ₹4,371.10 crore for FY 2026–27 to FY 2030–31. The scheme aims to strengthen official statistics through more timely data, improved interoperability and digital transformation.

articles.title: Rajasthan govt transfers ₹482 crore to 66 lakh students through DBT: CM
articles.summary: The assistance includes ₹800 per student for uniforms and school bags for students in Classes 1 to 8 in government schools and girls in Classes 9 to 12.

articles.title: India's services growth accelerates to 55.8 in October, cost pressures ease to six-year low
articles.summary: India's services sector activity expanded at its fastest pace in four months in October, with the HSBC India Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) rising to 55.8 from 55.2 in September, while input cost inflation eased to its lowest level in more than six years, according to data released by S&P Global on Wednesday.

articles.title: BHASHINI and SEBI explore multilingual AI for investor information
articles.summary: The Digital India BHASHINI Division and SEBI have signed an MoU to explore multilingual AI and language technologies for investor education and access to financial information. The collaboration focuses on making financial information and services more accessible across India’s language communities.

articles.title: SEBI inks MoU with Digital India BHASHINI Division to deliver services in regional languages
articles.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) on Tuesday to expand investor access across regional Indian languages, according to an official SEBI press release.

articles.title: CERT-In gets Mythos access; to assess its use in measured manner: IT Ministry sources
articles.summary: CERT-In has gained access to Anthropic's Mythos AI model and will cautiously assess its capabilities. The agency intends to explore how best to utilize the model for cybersecurity without rushing its implementation.

articles.title: MeitY unveils indigenous AI Models EKA-1, Dhīr 2B and 5B under IndiaAI mission
articles.summary: The IndiaAI Mission, part of the Ministry of Electronics and IT, recently unveiled three indigenous AI models. EKA-1 is designed for banking and cybersecurity, while Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B focus on low-connectivity environments.

articles.title: India–UK education partnership shifts beyond student mobility to AI, design and creative industries
articles.summary: Shannon West of the British Council and Pearl Academy President Aditi Srivastava discuss how AI, creative industries, global partnerships and entrepreneurship are reshaping India–UK education ties.

articles.title: India plans indigenous GPU chips in 24 months, says MeitY Secretary S Krishnan on AI strategy
articles.summary: MeitY Secretary S Krishnan outlines India's plans for indigenous GPU chips, Semicon 2.0, sovereign AI, data protection and new opportunities for the IT industry amid AI-driven transformation.

articles.title: IndiaAI Mission releases new indigenous foundation models
articles.summary: The IndiaAI Mission has announced the release of EKA-1 and the Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B models under its IndiaAI Innovation Centre pillar. The models are presented as Indian-developed AI systems with multilingual capabilities and potential applications across sectors.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu tops states in research publications on Niti Aayog's S&T scoreboard
articles.summary: Releasing the 'India S&T Scoreboard' report, Niti Aayog vice chairman Ashok Kumar Lahiri said India's further progress in science and technology requires a more active role by states.

articles.title: Karnataka signs LoI with Finland's Business Tampere to explore creative corridor
articles.summary: The LoI has been signed by the state government, under the Global Innovation Alliance (GIA) initiative of the Department of Electronics, Information Technology and Biotechnology, through the Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS), officials said.

articles.title: Bihar CM says Farakka Treaty restricts state's industrial water access
articles.summary: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary highlighted the need for adequate water to promote economic development. He pointed out that the Farakka Water Treaty restricts Bihar to receive water for only four months each year.

articles.title: India has never allowed import of GM products, will not do so in future: Goyal
articles.summary: India's Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal reiterated that the country will not allow genetically modified products. He emphasized the sensitivity of the dairy sector, stating there have been no duty concessions in free trade agreements.

articles.title: MEA condemns attack on vessel off Oman coast that kills one Indian national
articles.summary: India condemns the attack on MSV AL JUSUFI near Limah, Oman, as 13 of the 14 Indian nationals onboard are rescued; Embassy coordinates repatriation of survivors and mortal remains.

articles.title: Need to make judicial system more accessible, efficient through modern tech: CJI Surya Kant
articles.summary: Chief Justice Surya Kant inaugurated the Jharkhand High Court data centre and highlighted technological advancements in the judiciary.

articles.title: Visakhapatnam prepares to host CII Partnership Summit
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh is preparing to host the two-day CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam on 12 and 13 November. State officials are coordinating arrangements and outreach to domestic and international investors, with the event expected to bring industry representatives together to explore investment and partnership opportunities.

articles.title: Delhi schools told to set up anti-tobacco committees, ensure drug-free campuses
articles.summary: According to a circular issued by the Educational and Vocational Guidance and Counselling Bureau, the directions were issued under the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan and Nasha Mukt Delhi Campaign to promote preventive education, early identification, counselling and referral services.

articles.title: Haryana CM Saini invites Punjab industrialists to invest in state
articles.summary: Haryana Chief Minister Nayab Singh Saini said the Haryana government is making continuous efforts to accelerate industrial development and create an investor-friendly environment in the state.

articles.title: Sebi allows REITs, InvITs to issue depository receipts
articles.summary: Sebi has permitted the issuance of Depository Receipts against the units of Real Estate Investment Trusts and Infrastructure Investment Trusts. This move aims to draw more foreign investment into these financial instruments, enhancing capital inflow.

articles.title: Tatas important for economy; differences should be settled amicably: FM
articles.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman highlighted the importance of resolving the differences between Tata Sons and Tata Trusts. She stated that the matter is crucial for the Indian economy and should not be publicized further.

articles.title: 19 institutions recognised as Centres of Excellence-Skills
articles.summary: India’s Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship has recognised 19 institutions as Centres of Excellence-Skills. The network spans renewable energy, chemicals, construction, marine engineering, agriculture and other sectors, with the aim of strengthening advanced, industry-aligned training capacity.

articles.title: NTPC to set up India's first ceramic-based project to generate solar power at night in Rajasthan's Bhadla
articles.summary: The project aims to assess the possibility of generating solar power at night while reducing dependence on conventional battery storage.

articles.title: India likely to meet FY27 fiscal deficit target despite spending pressures: Goldman Sachs
articles.summary: The Centre is likely to meet its fiscal deficit target of 4.3 per cent of GDP for FY27 despite the deficit reaching 42.6 per cent of the full-year estimate in the first six months, as stronger corporate tax collections are helping offset revenue pressures, according to a report by Goldman Sachs Research.

articles.title: Akshaya Patra targets six million daily meals by 2030, expands focus on child nutrition
articles.summary: Bharatarshabha Dasa outlines Akshaya Patra's Mission 2030, its expansion plans, use of AI and technology, government partnerships, and the shift from addressing classroom hunger to tackling child malnutrition.

articles.title: UP to launch state Quantum Mission, steps up push to build AI and robotics ecosystem
articles.summary: The proposed mission is part of a broader push to strengthen the state’s emerging technology ecosystem, attract investments, expand AI adoption and create new opportunities for startups and industry.

articles.title: UPI transactions cross 25 billion in October, daily value tops ₹1 lakh crore
articles.summary: UPI processed 25.47 billion transactions worth ₹31.53 lakh crore in October, compared with 24.07 billion transactions valued at ₹29.37 lakh crore in September. Transaction volumes rose 5.8 per cent month on month, while the value of payments increased 7.4 per cent.

articles.title: Gross GST collections rise 23% to over ₹2.31 lakh crore in October
articles.summary: Gross GST collections from domestic sales rose 16 per cent to over ₹1.59 lakh crore, and revenues from imports climbed 42 per cent to ₹72,246 crore.

articles.title: Commercial LPG price raised by ₹10, ATF rates up for fourth straight month
articles.summary: The commercial LPG price revision marks another increase for hotels, restaurants and other commercial consumers. This is the second consecutive monthly hike, following a ₹62.50 increase per 19-kg cylinder on October 1. Rates had also risen by ₹9.50 on September 1.

articles.title: Round-the-clock clean power key to Uttar Pradesh’s industrial competitiveness: Hinduja Renewables CEO
articles.summary: Deepak Thakur, Managing Director and CEO of Hinduja Renewables Energy, argued that renewable energy must increasingly be viewed as an instrument of industrial competitiveness, investment and economic growth, rather than merely an alternative source of electricity.

articles.title: Union Bank of India expands banking infrastructure in Uttar Pradesh, MD inaugurates new facilities
articles.summary: MD and CEO Asheesh Pandey lays foundation stone for a new building in Lucknow and inaugurates a Mid Corporate Branch, employee basketball turf and regional office in Kanpur during his two-day visit.

articles.title: India’s sovereign AI push moves from foundational models to real-world applications for Bharat: Ganesh Ramakrishnan
articles.summary: BharatGen’s Ganesh Ramakrishnan says building AI for India's linguistic diversity, data sovereignty and public-sector needs will be critical to achieving the country’s Viksit Bharat 2047 vision.

articles.title: Uttar Pradesh looks beyond Lucknow, Noida to expand startup ecosystem
articles.summary: Two partnerships announced at Sankalp Bharat 2026 aim to connect entrepreneurs with investors, mentors and markets, while taking people-first AI to 25 districts in eastern UP.

articles.title: Ananth Technologies supplies critical avionics, electronics systems for ISRO's GSLV-F18, NVS-03 mission
articles.summary: Hyderabad-based company contributes 46 avionics packages for the launch vehicle and nine spacecraft systems, highlighting the expanding role of India's private industry in space missions.

articles.title: Hinduja Group committed to partnering with UP in its journey towards $1 trillion economy: S K Chadda
articles.summary: At ET Vision Conclave 5.0 in Lucknow, Hinduja Group President – Corporate Affairs S K Chadda highlighted investments in electric mobility, healthcare, education and digital entrepreneurship, and praised UP’s investor-friendly approach.
